ATP PART I – CIVIL & STRUCTURAL 1 Dimensional Verification: Total Length 120m, Width 30m, Firing Lane 100m, 06 lanes, tolerance ±1%. 2 Structural Strength Test: Verify wall integrity, roof load, vibration resistance, compliance to structural s tandards. 3 Acoustic Test: Internal sound ≤140 dB, external leakage within prescribed norms. PART II – BALLISTIC TEST 1 Bullet Trap Test: 500 rounds/lane using 5.56mm, 7.62mm, 9mm rounds to verify no penetration, ricoc het or damage. 2 Ricochet Test: Random angle firing; zero unsafe ricochet acceptable. 3 Spall Test: No backward fragmentation allowed. 4 Bullet Collection Test: Minimum 95% bullet recovery. PART III – TARGET SYSTEM 1 Static Target Test: 100 cycles, ≥98% success. 2 Turning Target Test: 1–10 sec programmable, 200 cycles. 3 Moving Target Test: Speed 0.5–5 m/sec, verify track accuracy. 4 Running Man Test: 100 cycles, ≤2% failure tolerance. 5 Wireless Command Test: Latency ≤1 sec, full range coverage. PART IV – HVAC & VENTILATION 1 Airflow Test: Laminar flow 50–75 FPM. 2 Negative Pressure Test: Continuous pressure differential monitoring. 3 HEPA Filtration Test: 99.97% efficiency. 4 Lead Dust Test: Lead within permissible norms. PART V – ELECTRICAL 1 Load Test: Full load for 8 hrs, no overheating. 2 UPS Test: Full operational backup as per specification. 3 Emergency Lighting Test: Auto activation on power failure. PART VI – SOFTWARE 1 Shot Detection Test: Accuracy ≥98%. 2 Data Recording Test: Shooter data, score, timing, analytics. 3 Replay Test: Playback without corruption. 4 Report Generation Test: PDF/Excel generation. PART VII – SAFETY 1 Emergency Stop Test: Shutdown within <3 sec. 2 Fire Alarm Test: Sensor activation. 3 Fire Suppression Test: Functional demonstration. 4 CCTV Test: All cameras functional with 30-day backup. 5 PA System Test: Clear communication in all areas. PART VIII – ENDURANCE 1 Continuous Operation Test: 8 hrs all systems live. 2 Stress Firing Test: 5000 mixed caliber rounds, verify trap, ventilation and targets. Acceptance Criteria 1 100% critical parameters passed. 2 Minimum 95% non-critical parameters passed. 3 No safety failure. 4 No ballistic failure. 5 No ricochet. 6 No lead hazard.
